title: Public Sector Sales Lead
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As Anthropic's Public Sector Sales Lead for France, you will be the face of Anthropic to the French State. This is a founding, zero-to-one role: there is no public sector team in France today, and you will build our strategy, our routes to market and our first strategic relationships from the ground up. Reporting to our EMEA South leadership, you will lead the adoption of safe, frontier AI across central government, starting with the largest ministries. You will work hand in hand with our Public Policy lead in Paris, because in few companies is policy as central to the mission as it is at Anthropic, and with Partnerships, Legal, Security and Product to put in place the commercial and compliance frameworks the State needs in order to work with us at scale.

This is a senior individual contributor role. We expect you to have run a public sector business and led teams, and to be energised by stepping back into a hands-on seat where you build it yourself and where the size of your team says nothing about the size of your scope. In the first year, success is measured less by a large number and more by putting Anthropic on the map with the French State: a clear strategy, the right foundations and our first strategic agreements.

Responsibilities

• Define and own Anthropic's public sector go-to-market strategy for France: where we play first, how

• Design and refine Ford .com experiences that help Owners find vehicle information, understand features, access services, and stay connected with Ford .

title: GTM, Strategic Planning
description:
Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search - all deeply integrated and designed for growth. We're building the best developer platform to power the next generation of software companies, and our go-to-market team is scaling fast to match.

We're looking for a lead in Go-To-Market Strategic Planning, to shape how Supabase's GTM engine runs. This is a high-leverage, high-ownership role that sits at the intersection of strategy, data, and execution. You'll work directly with Success, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Partnerships and Product to build the systems, processes, and insights that help our go-to-market teams move faster and smarter.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own the end-to-end GTM Strategic Planning, covering territory design, segmentation design, target planning and GTM capacity planning.

- Build and maintain a single source of truth for planning data across HubSpot, BigQuery and Hex.

- Translate company priorities into field actions through designing the planning strategy and seeing it through to execution.

- Partner with Sales Leadership to design and iterate on coverage models, segmentation, and team structures that reflect how developers actually buy.

- Define and track the metrics that matter, and surface insights that drive action, not just reporting.

- Lead the Strategic Planning roadmap: guide and lead in tooling investments and evaluate new systems and processes against real business needs.

- Work cross-functionally with talent acquisition, ensuring GTM and territory models stay aligned.

- Collaborate with GTM Engineering on automations and data pipelines so that your strategy translates into working systems, not just slide decks.

WE'LL EXPECT YOU TO

- Operate with high ownership. You set your own agenda, escalate when needed, and don't wait to be asked.

- Work asynchronously and document clearly. We're a globally distributed team and writing is how we think.

- Bridge strategy and execution. From drafting segmentation approaches in Google Docs to using SQL to monitor its effectiveness.

- Build for scale without over-engineering. Simple systems that work beat perfect systems that don't ship.

- Stay close to the customer. Developers are our buyers, and understanding how they discover, adopt, and expand is core to everything you'll do.

YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF YOU

- Have 6+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Strategy Consulting, GTM Strategy, or Sales Operations at a B2B SaaS or developer-tools company.

- Are fluent in the GTM stack: HubSpot, BigQuery, and Hightouch.

- Can write SQL comfortably and aren't afraid to get into the data yourself before asking an analyst.

- Have experience designing or overhauling sales processes, forecasting cadences, or territory models in a high-growth environment.

- Understand product-led growth motions: PLS, usage-based triggers, and how PLG data flows into commercial pipelines.

- Thrive with autonomy and are energized by building things that didn't exist before you joined.

- Communicate with clarity across Finance, Sales, Success, Partnerships, Engineering, and Marketing without losing nuance.

description:
ABOUT NEXGEN CLOUD

NexGen Cloud is a fast-growing GPU cloud and AI infrastructure business. We’re the company behind Hyperstack - a self-serve, on-demand cloud platform built for high-performance AI, HPC, and compute-heavy workloads. Powered by 100% renewable energy and NVIDIA architecture, Hyperstack gives teams from AI startups to enterprise the compute they need, without the cost or complexity of legacy cloud.

Our hardest problems don’t stay in one layer. A customer issue can start in a web app and end in a Kubernetes scheduler, a container runtime or a GPU driver. We need engineers who can build the products, APIs and tools our customers use, and who understand the systems underneath well enough to make them work reliably in production.

This is a role for someone who takes a loosely defined problem, works out what the user actually needs, and owns the solution end to end. That means designing it, writing the code, shipping it, and debugging it when it breaks, without handing it off at the first layer boundary.

• Own and drive user-facing products end to end, including web apps, APIs, backend services and CLI tools, mostly in Go. You’ll ship the simplest useful version first, then improve it based on how people actually use it.

• Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering & DevOps, Infrastructure & Data Centre Operations
